title: supervisor prompt gains the advisor-nudge wording
action: Per 3cfd9980 (plan S3). In skills/bee-herding/references/supervisor-prompt.md: add the advisor-nudge record to the supervisor's vocabulary — when poor-work evidence supports it (struggling-loop, budget-overrun, same-region-resubmit), the tick records kind advisor-nudge recommending an advisor consult for the target session, worded under the existing intervention rules (open question framing, evidence named, two sentences); the supervisor never summons the advisor itself (704b691c) and the target lead owns the response. Name the response debt in one line so a reader knows silence refuses the cap. Keep the file's four-step tick structure and closed-set style intact; the doc must agree with the code's kind and signal names (parity check: rg the literal strings in both). ALSO: refresh the stale help prose in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/catalog.rs — the --signal description still names only big-decision/danger-op/none and --kind still names intervention/escalation/urgent; bring both in line with the widened sets (help prose only, but registry/help parity tests may pin it — run them). This cell owns the regen: run bee dev regen (render-skill-trees, then onboard --repo-root . --apply, then release-manifest --write, in that order) inside this cell.
